annotations.description: Gem3F Valley passed with no action when they could cast Wan Shi Tong for X=6 (7/7 flying vigilance, draw 3 cards) against an empty board. The opponent has no creatures and limited removal options in mono-green for a large flyer. This was the perfect window to deploy a game-winning threat.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed the turn without casting any spells, despite having 8 mana and Wan Shi Tong in hand against an empty board.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Wan Shi Tong, Librarian for X=6, creating a 7/7 flying vigilance creature and drawing 3 cards. This establishes a dominant board presence and card advantage against an opponent with no creatures and no easy answers to a large flyer.

annotations.description: Gem3F Valley passed the turn with 8 lands available and two copies of Wan Shi Tong in hand, missing the opportunity to deploy a large flying threat with card draw while still holding up countermagic. The opponent has no creatures on board, so there's minimal risk, and Wan Shi Tong for X=4 (5/5 flyer, draw 2) with Spell Pierce or Spell Snare backup would be a powerful, protected clock.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without casting anything
annotations.betterLine: Cast Wan Shi Tong, Librarian for X=4 (6 mana total: 4+UU), creating a 5/5 flying vigilance that draws 2 cards, while keeping 2 mana open for Spell Pierce or Spell Snare to protect it.

annotations.description: Gem3F Valley passed with 8 lands available and no creatures on the opponent's board to pressure them, missing the opportunity to deploy Wan Shi Tong, Librarian at end of turn. With X=3 (paying 3UU), they could flash in a 4/4 flyer with vigilance and draw 1 card, establishing a clock and card advantage. The opponent has no board presence (only lands and enchantments), so there's minimal risk. Alternatively, they could activate Fountainport to create a Fish token or Treasure as a mana sink. Passing with all that mana unused wastes tempo.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting anything or activating any abilities.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Wan Shi Tong, Librarian with X=3 (or higher) at end of opponent's turn to flash in a meaningful threat while keeping Spell Pierce/Spell Snare available earlier in the turn. At minimum, activate Fountainport to create a token or Treasure as a mana sink.

annotations.description: Played Undercity Sewers which enters tapped instead of Gloomlake Verge which would enter untapped (they control Islands and Swamps). This costs 1 available mana this turn for a marginal surveil 1. Given they have countermagic in hand (Spell Snare, Spell Pierce), having maximum mana available is important for flexibility.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Undercity Sewers (enters tapped, surveil 1)
annotations.betterLine: Play Gloomlake Verge (enters untapped since they control Islands/Swamps), saving the tapped Undercity Sewers for a later turn. This maximizes available mana for holding up interaction alongside any proactive plays.

annotations.description: Discarding Spell Pierce instead of an excess land when already at 8 lands on the battlefield. While Spell Pierce gets weaker in the late game as opponents can pay {2} more easily, it still has some utility against Archdruid's Charm or other noncreature spells. Extra lands beyond 8 provide essentially no value.
annotations.actionTaken: Discarded Spell Pierce as the 3rd discard to hand size
annotations.betterLine: Discard a redundant land like Swamp, Undercity Sewers, or Gloomlake Verge instead, keeping Spell Pierce as a potential cheap interaction piece

annotations.description: With Icetill Explorer in hand (which allows playing lands from the graveyard), discarding a Forest instead of Llanowar Elves would effectively make the discard free - the Forest could be replayed from the graveyard later. Llanowar Elves, while low-impact with 7+ lands in play, is permanently lost when discarded and represents a body that can attack/block.
annotations.actionTaken: Discarded Llanowar Elves
annotations.betterLine: Discard a Forest, since Icetill Explorer (in hand) allows playing lands from the graveyard, making the Forest discard essentially free while preserving Llanowar Elves as an additional creature option.

annotations.description: Playing a tapped land (Undercity Sewers) when untapped alternatives like Gloomlake Verge or Swamp were available. With Feed the Cycle in hand and potential need for instant-speed interaction, having more untapped mana is preferable. The surveil 1 is marginal value compared to mana flexibility.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Undercity Sewers (enters tapped, surveil 1)
annotations.betterLine: Play Gloomlake Verge (enters untapped, produces U or B) to maintain mana flexibility for Feed the Cycle or other instant-speed plays, saving Undercity Sewers for a later turn when tapped entry matters less.

annotations.description: Gem3F Valley passed with 8 lands available when they could cast Wan Shi Tong, Librarian for X=6, creating a 7/7 flying vigilance creature that draws 3 cards. The opponent is at 9 life with no creatures on the battlefield, making this a near-game-winning play. The opponent is a green deck with very limited ways to deal with a large flyer.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without casting any spells, leaving all mana unused.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Wan Shi Tong, Librarian for X=6 (8 mana total), creating a 7/7 flying vigilance that draws 3 cards, presenting lethal in 2 attacks against the opponent at 9 life while refilling the hand.

annotations.description: Paid 2 life to play Watery Grave untapped when they already had 8 lands with ample U/B mana. Free alternatives like Gloomlake Verge (enters untapped with Island/Swamp in play), Swamp, or Demolition Field were available and would have provided equal or better utility without the life cost.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Watery Grave from hand, paying 2 life to have it enter untapped.
annotations.betterLine: Play Demolition Field (provides a second copy to threaten opponent's Ba Sing Se, costs no life) or Gloomlake Verge (enters untapped for free, adds U or B).

annotations.description: Gem3F Valley passed their entire main phase with Wan Shi Tong, Librarian in hand and 8 mana available, against an opponent at 9 life with no creatures. Wan Shi Tong for X=6 would create a 7/7 flying vigilance creature and draw 3 cards, representing a near-certain win. Playing a land first (Swamp/Gloomlake Verge) would allow X=7 for an 8/8 drawing 3.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without playing any spells or lands
annotations.betterLine: Play Gloomlake Verge or Swamp, then cast Wan Shi Tong, Librarian for X=7, creating an 8/8 flying vigilance creature and drawing 3 cards against an opponent at 9 life with no blockers
